title: revert(app-shell): roll back objectui#11931 and objectui#11932 so the console's eager closure is under its ceiling again (objectui#11937)
body:
Fixes #11937
Part of #11861
Rolls back objectui#11932 (objectui#11823, seat `domain:ui#3`) as well: measured necessary, see the report

Clause-②: no

`main` is red on `Bundle Analysis`: the console's eager closure is over its 3,386,364-byte gzip ceiling. This PR rolls back the two Studio changes whose strings pushed it over, so `main` returns to the tree of f1781be, which measured under the ceiling. The route is the seat's ruling A, under the maintainer's ruling 6056819248 step 1: `main` turns green by rollback or plugging, and the ceiling is not raised.

Implemented by the os-dev agent of session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU` (seat `domain:ui#2`, claim comment 6056334737).

## What changed

- `git revert -m 1 19a7348` (objectui#11931: Studio's validation "New" menu presets) and `git revert -m 1 f3a0488` (objectui#11932: Studio Interfaces' page create step), one commit each.
- `.changeset/11937-eager-budget-rollback.md`, a patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`. The two rolled-back PRs' unreleased changesets are removed with them, so the next release does not announce what is not in it.
- `git diff f1781be HEAD --stat` prints only `.changeset/11937-eager-budget-rollback.md | 5 +++++`.
- Not touched: `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` and every other ceiling, `apps/console/vite.config.ts`, `.github/**`.

## Measurement

These are local console builds (`CI=1 pnpm exec vite build` in `apps/console`, under the container's verify lock), read from `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`. The ceiling is 3,386,364 B.

| tree | eager gzip bytes | vs ceiling | eager `i18n` chunk |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| f1781be (objectui#11929) | 3,385,951 | −413 | 104,156 |
| 19a7348 (+ objectui#11931) | 3,386,368 | +4 | 104,569 |
| f3a0488 (+ objectui#11932, `main`) | 3,386,819 | +455 | 105,029 |
| f3a0488 − objectui#11931 only | 3,386,430 | +66 | 104,635 |
| this PR (tree = f1781be + changeset) | 3,385,951 | −413 | 104,156 |

- The 19a7348 and f3a0488 rows match CI's push runs to the 0.1 KB: 3307.0 KB, "0.0 KB over"; and 3307.4 KB, 0.4 KB over.
- Almost all of the growth is in one eager chunk, `i18n-*.js`: +413 B from 11931 and +460 B from 11932. Every other eager chunk moved by 7 B or less, which is minifier and hash churn.
- `chunk-membership.json` puts exactly one workspace module in that chunk: app-shell's designer string table, `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`.
- 11931's code (the preset table and the panel) is only in the lazy `studioBuilder` chunk. Only its 12 table rows are eager.

**Why rolling back 11931 alone is not enough, and why there is no leak to plug.**

- objectui#11932 added its own rows to the same table.
- The table's chunk is an automatic chunk. No `advancedChunks` group matches its path, so it is not a chunk-group leak.
- 8 eager chunks import it statically:
  - the register-builtins inspector path, eager by design (ruling A 6054102412, objectui#6795's order): `apps/console/src/main.tsx` → `@object-ui/app-shell` → `views/metadata-admin/register-builtins.ts` → `inspectors/index.ts` → `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` → `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`;
  - runtime surfaces: `views/ViewConfigPanel.tsx` and `views/ReportConfigPanel.tsx` → `views/RuntimeDraftBar.tsx` → `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`.
- Moving Studio-only rows out of that table is the lazy-loading step objectui#6795 orders second. That is objectui#11942, not this PR.

## Verification (head `b1e82226c`)

- **Tests**, run under the lock with repo-root `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 FILES`. The set is 179 files: every test file that 11932's revert touches or that imports a module either revert changes (`interfaceCreate`, `StudioDesignSurface`, the metadata-admin i18n table), plus the remaining `ObjectValidationsPanel*` suites and `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/column-identity.ratchet.test.ts`. batch 00: 'Test Files 44 passed (44)', 'Tests 489 passed (489)'; batch 01: 'Test Files 45 passed (45)', 'Tests 631 passed (631)'; batch 02: 'Test Files 45 passed (45)', 'Tests 221 passed (221)'; batch 03: 'Test Files 45 passed (45)', 'Tests 641 passed (641)'. Total 179 files and 1982 tests passed.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0. The dependency closure was built first (`--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build`, exit 0).
- **Gates, all exit 0:** `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check-changeset-presence` ("this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`.
- **`check-changeset-overwrite`** is report-only. It lists the two removed changesets as its case 3, superseded in the same change.
- **`pnpm exec eslint`** on the 8 touched source and test files: 0 errors and 19 react-hooks warnings. All 8 files are byte-identical to their f1781be blobs.
- **No console build on this head**, as the PM directed: the tree is f1781be's. CI's `Bundle Analysis` on this PR re-measures.
